summary: Phase C Vague 2 (Acquisition Engine + Revenue Management) fully validated. critical_code_review_comments: revenue_management.py _resolve(): when both promo and weekend match on the same date, priority sort works as designed (promo:4 > weekend:1) — verified end-to-end at /api/revenue/quote.

revenue_management.py POST validates promo_code only via `(promo_code or '').strip()` — Pydantic field already trims via max_length but a stripped empty string still bypasses the model. Current check correctly raises 400 in that case (verified).
marketing_campaigns.py /acquisition endpoint correctly injects missing universe×offer pairs (zero counters) so the 15-card matrix is guaranteed even on an empty DB.

Frontend StaffRatePlans.jsx — OFFER_KEYS hardcoded list duplicates the universe.offer naming convention from the CMS. Consider exposing a /api/staff/revenue/offer-keys meta endpoint later to avoid drift.
Console log noise: a benign 404 (likely a sidebar /unread badge probe) prints repeatedly on every page navigation — not blocking but worth tracking down.
seed_data_creation: Created (and cleaned up) TEST_ rate plans for weekend/promo + a UI-created 'UI_TEST_seasonal_summer' plan removed via API after the run. Test campaign 'TEST_audience_camp' was created and remains (used as PATCH target).
